actions.action: Set up a clip-on grow light near a south- or east-facing window
Check soil moisture with a wooden skewer or chopstick
Water when the skewer comes out dry
Repot into a pot with drainage holes
Mix cactus soil from 3 parts potting soil, 2 parts coarse sand and 1 part perlite
If in a humid climate, place a small dehumidifier nearby or keep the plant in an air-conditioned room
In winter, move the plant away from drafty windows toward the center of the room
Feed half-strength succulent fertilizer monthly in spring and summer

verdict.reason: The answer is a generic care guide with no diagnosis of underwatering; it mentions drainage-hole pots and a gritty soil mix among many unrelated tips but says nothing about deep or bottom watering, and none of its suggestions are likely to harm the plant.
